population.kidComparison: Vietnam is one of the world's most populated nations, home to about 101.6 million people.

geography.climate: Subtropical to warm temperate climate, ranging from sunny coasts to dry inland areas.
geography.terrain: Mix of coastal plains and inland terrain.

anthem.title: National Anthem of Vietnam

exploration.didYouKnow: Vietnam is located in South-Eastern Asia and its capital city is Hanoi.
